mainTopic: The opening משנה of מסכת שבועות: the 'two that are four' list, and which קרבנות atone for entering the מקדש or eating קדשים while טמא, depending on what the person knew.
overview: The מסכת opens with a list built on one repeating pattern: 'two that are four.' In four topics (שבועות, ידיעות הטומאה, יציאות השבת, and מראות נגעים), the תורה states two cases, and חז"ל show there are really four. The משנה then goes back to the case of a טמא person who entered the מקדש or ate קדשים. It explains what atones for him, depending on whether he knew about the sin before it happened, after it happened, both, or neither. If he knew both before and after, he brings a קרבן עולה ויורד. If he knew only before, the inner שעיר of יום הכיפורים holds off his punishment until he finds out. If he knew only after, the outer שעיר of יום הכיפורים atones, and a פסוק links the two goats to prove this. If he never knew at all, רבי יהודה says the goats of the רגלים and of ראש חודש atone, while רבי שמעון says only the רגלים goats do. The amud ends by asking what the ראש חודש goats atone for according to רבי שמעון, and the answer comes on the next amud.

steps.title: Oaths: two that are four
steps.stepSummary: The משנה opens by saying that שבועות (oaths someone speaks with his lips) come in two types that are really four.
steps.simpleTranslation: Oaths: there are two types, which are really four.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה opens the מסכת with its main topic, שבועות. It says the תורה lists two kinds of oaths, but there are really four.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה speaks of an oath about the future: 'I will do X' or 'I will not do X.' חז"ל learn that the same law applies to an oath about the past: 'I did X' or 'I did not do X.' So the two kinds in the פסוק become four.

keyTerms.meaning: Our משנה; marks the start of the משנה text
Oaths; here, oaths a person speaks with his lips (שְׁבוּעַת בִּטּוּי)
Two that are four: two cases written in the תורה, with two more learned from them

steps.confusionAlert: 'Two that are four' does not mean two plus four (six). It means the two cases written in the תורה expand into four cases in total.
steps.whyThisMatters: This line sets up the whole מסכת, which spends most of its time on the laws of שבועות.

phrases.english: MISHNA: Oaths
phrases.notes: This means oaths a person says out loud about doing or not doing something (ויקרא 5:4).

phrases.english: are two types that are four.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: There are two types of שבועות written in the תורה (future: to do / not to do), which become four once past-tense oaths are included.

steps.title: Awareness of impurity: two that are four
steps.stepSummary: The משנה applies the same 'two that are four' pattern to cases where someone forgot about טומאה and entered the מקדש or ate קדשים.
steps.simpleTranslation: Cases of awareness of impurity: there are two types, which are really four.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the second item in its list. It again uses the pattern 'two that are four,' this time for ידיעות הטומאה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A טמא person may not enter the מקדש or eat קדשים. The תורה speaks of someone who forgot that he was טמא, and that gives two cases. חז"ל add two more cases: he knew he was טמא but forgot that the place was the מקדש, or forgot that the food was קדשים. That makes four.

keyTerms.meaning: Cases of awareness (knowing, forgetting, and then finding out)
Ritual impurity
The בית המקדש, which a טמא person may not enter
Holy foods from קרבנות, which a טמא person may not eat

phrases.english: Cases of awareness of impurity
phrases.notes: He means someone who forgot something, did the act while טמא, and later found out.

phrases.english: are two types that are four.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second topic that follows the same 'two that are four' pattern as שבועות.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: ידיעות הטומאה have two cases in the תורה (forgetting one is טמא, for the מקדש or קדשים), which become four once forgetting the place or the food is included.

steps.title: Carrying out on שבת: two that are four
steps.stepSummary: The משנה applies the same pattern to carrying an object from one domain to another on שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: Acts of carrying out on שבת: there are two types, which are really four.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the third item in its list, יציאות השבת. These are acts of moving an object between a private area and a public area on שבת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה refers to two cases of carrying from the רשות היחיד to the רשות הרבים. In one, the person doing it stands in the private area, and in the other he stands in the public area. חז"ל learn that bringing an object in, from public to private, is also included, so there are four.

keyTerms.meaning: Acts of carrying out (moving an object between domains)
Private domain
Public domain

phrases.english: Acts of carrying out on Shabbat
are two types that are four.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a third topic that follows the same pattern.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: יציאות השבת have two cases in the תורה (carrying out), which become four once bringing in is included.

steps.title: Shades of leprous marks: two that are four
steps.stepSummary: The משנה ends its list with the shades of white of נגעים, which are two main shades that become four.
steps.simpleTranslation: Shades of leprous marks: there are two types, which are really four.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the fourth and last item in its list, מראות נגעים. These are the shades of white of a צרעת mark on the skin.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה names two main kinds of marks, בהרת and שאת. חז"ל learn that each one has a secondary, slightly different shade that is also a נגע. So the two become four.

keyTerms.meaning: Appearances; here, shades of color
Marks of צָרַעַת on the skin
One of the two main shades of נגע named in the תורה
The other main shade of נגע named in the תורה

steps.whatToRemember: The whole משנה is one pattern repeated four times: the תורה writes two cases, and חז"ל show there are four. The real subject of the מסכת is שבועות, and the other three are listed only because they share this pattern.

phrases.english: Shades of leprous marks
are two types that are four.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the list of four topics that share the 'two that are four' pattern.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מראות נגעים are two main shades (בהרת and שאת), each with a secondary shade, making four.

steps.title: Knowing at the start and at the end means bringing a sliding-scale offering
steps.stepSummary: If a person knew he was טמא before the sin, forgot during the sin, and found out afterward, he brings a קרבן עולה ויורד.
steps.simpleTranslation: A case where the person knew at the beginning, knew at the end, and forgot in between: he brings a sliding-scale offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה returns to the case of a טמא person who entered the מקדש or ate קדשים. It gives the first scenario: he knew before, forgot during the sin, and knew again after.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are three moments here: knowing at the start, forgetting during the act, and knowing at the end. When all three happen, the person brings a קרבן עולה ויורד. The price of this offering depends on how much money he has.

keyTerms.meaning: Awareness. Knowing that he is טמא and that the place or food is holy.
A lapse in awareness, when he forgot at the time of the sin.
In between, meaning at the moment the sin happened.
A sliding-scale offering. A rich person brings an animal, a poorer person brings birds, and a very poor person brings flour.

steps.confusionAlert: Forgetting in the middle is required. If he knew the whole time, it was done on purpose, and no קרבן atones for it.

phrases.english: A case in which there was awareness at the beginning
phrases.notes: "בָּהּ" refers to the טומאה case: entering the מקדש or eating קדשים while טמא.

phrases.english: and awareness at the end
and a lapse of awareness in between
this person brings a sliding-scale offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ יְדִיעָה בַּתְּחִלָּה וִידִיעָה בַּסּוֹף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to the טומאה case from step 2 and starts explaining the atonement for it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Awareness at the start and at the end, with forgetting in between, requires a קרבן עולה ויורד.

steps.title: Knowing only at the start: the inner goat holds off punishment
steps.stepSummary: If he knew before the sin but has not yet found out afterward, the inner שעיר and יום הכיפורים hold off his punishment until he finds out and brings a קרבן עולה ויורד.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he knew at the beginning but not at the end, the goat done inside and יום הכיפורים hold things off until he finds out, and then he brings a sliding-scale offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the second scenario: he knew before the sin but still has not realized he sinned.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here the inner שעיר does not fully atone. It only holds off punishment. Full atonement still waits until he finds out and brings his own קרבן עולה ויורד.

keyTerms.meaning: The goat of יום הכיפורים whose blood is sprinkled inside the היכל and קודש הקדשים.
The day itself, which also has power to atone.
Suspends. It holds off punishment for now but does not fully atone.

steps.confusionAlert: תולה is not the same as מכפר. The inner goat only pauses the punishment. He still owes a קרבן once he finds out.

phrases.english: If there was awareness at the beginning
but no awareness at the end
the goat that is done inside
phrases.notes: "Inside" means its blood is brought into the holy inner rooms on יום הכיפורים.

phrases.english: and יום הכיפורים suspend the punishment
until he becomes aware
and brings a sliding-scale offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: יֵשׁ בָּהּ יְדִיעָה בַּתְּחִלָּה וְאֵין בָּהּ יְדִיעָה בַּסּוֹף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second scenario in the same list: this time there is no awareness at the end.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: With awareness only at the beginning, the inner שעיר and יום הכיפורים are תולה until he finds out and brings a קרבן עולה ויורד.

steps.title: Knowing only at the end: the outer goat atones
steps.stepSummary: If he did not know before the sin but found out afterward, the outer שעיר of יום הכיפורים and the day itself fully atone.
steps.simpleTranslation: If there was no awareness at the beginning but there was awareness at the end, the goat done outside and יום הכיפורים atone.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the third scenario: he never knew before the sin and only realized it afterward.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Without knowing at the start, he cannot bring a קרבן עולה ויורד. Instead, the outer שעיר, the מוסף goat of יום הכיפורים, fully atones. Note the change from "suspends" (תולה) to "atones" (מכפר).

keyTerms.meaning: The מוסף goat of יום הכיפורים, whose blood is put on the outer מזבח.
Fully atones.

phrases.english: If there was no awareness at the beginning
but there was awareness at the end
the goat that is done outside
and יום הכיפורים atone.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֵין בָּהּ יְדִיעָה בַּתְּחִלָּה אֲבָל יֵשׁ בָּהּ יְדִיעָה בַּסּוֹף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Third scenario: the reverse of step 6, with awareness only at the end.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: With awareness only at the end, the outer שעיר and יום הכיפורים atone.

steps.title: The verse links the outer goat to the inner goat
steps.stepSummary: A פסוק places the two goats side by side. That teaches that the outer goat, like the inner one, atones only where there was some awareness.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it says, "aside from the sin-offering of the atonements." Whatever this one atones for, that one atones for. Just as the inner goat atones only where there was awareness, so too the outer goat atones only where there was awareness.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה brings a פסוק to prove the rule of step 7. It shows why the outer goat covers the case of knowing only at the end.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק mentions the outer goat "aside from" the inner one. That links them, so they work in a similar way. The inner goat needs knowing at the start, so the outer goat also needs some knowing, which here is the knowing at the end.

keyTerms.meaning: As it is said. This introduces a פסוק.
Aside from, besides.
The inner goat.
The outer goat.

steps.whyThisMatters: This explains why the outer goat does not cover cases with no awareness at all. That gap is filled by the next step.

phrases.english: As it is stated: "aside from the sin-offering of the atonements"

phrases.aramaic: עַל מַה שֶּׁזֶּה מְכַפֵּר, זֶה מְכַפֵּר;
phrases.english: for what this one atones, that one atones;
just as the inner goat atones

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא עַל דָּבָר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ יְדִיעָה,
phrases.english: only for something where there was awareness,
so too the outer goat atones

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא עַל דָּבָר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ יְדִיעָה.
phrases.english: only for something where there was awareness.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a scriptural source for the rule in step 7.
steps.raayaObject: The outer שעיר atones only where there was some awareness.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The פסוק "מלבד חטאת הכפורים" links the outer goat to the inner goat.

steps.title: No awareness at all: the יום טוב and ראש חודש goats atone, says רבי יהודה
steps.stepSummary: If he never knew, before or after, the goats brought on the רגלים and on ראש חודש atone. This is רבי יהודה's view.
steps.simpleTranslation: For a case with no awareness at the beginning or at the end, the goats of the festivals and the goats of ראש חודש atone. These are the words of רבי יהודה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the fourth and last scenario: the person never knew at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The יום כיפור goats need some awareness, so another קרבן must cover this case. רבי יהודה says both the festival goats and the ראש חודש goats do this.

keyTerms.meaning: The חטאת goats brought as part of the מוסף on פסח, שבועות and סוכות.
The חטאת goats brought as part of the מוסף on ראש חודש.

phrases.english: And for a case with no awareness
neither at the beginning nor at the end
the goats of the festivals
and the goats of the New Moons atone,
these are the words of רבי יהודה.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְעַל שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ יְדִיעָה לֹא בַּתְּחִלָּה וְלֹא בַּסּוֹף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Fourth scenario. It covers the case left open by steps 7 and 8.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי יהודה, with no awareness at all, the goats of the רגלים and of ראש חודש atone.

steps.title: רבי שמעון: only the festival goats atone for this
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון agrees that the festival goats atone when there was no awareness at all, but not the ראש חודש goats.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: the goats of the festivals atone, but not the goats of the New Moons.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי שמעון disagrees with part of רבי יהודה's view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both agree about the festival goats. They argue only about the ראש חודש goats, which רבי שמעון removes from this case.

keyTerms.meaning: But not.

phrases.english: רבי שמעון says:
the goats of the festivals atone,
but not the goats of the New Moons.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Argues with רבי יהודה's ruling in step 9.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי שמעון, only the festival goats atone where there was no awareness at all.

steps.title: So what do the ראש חודש goats atone for?
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון's view raises a question: if the ראש חודש goats do not atone for this case, what do they atone for?
steps.simpleTranslation: And for what do the goats of the New Moons atone?
steps.whatsHappening: This question sets up the next move. רבי שמעון, still speaking, is about to explain what the ראש חודש goats atone for according to רבי שמעון.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון took the ראש חודש goats out of the no-awareness case. But a חטאת must atone for something. So רבי שמעון himself asks what their job is, and the answer comes on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: And for what?
They atone (plural).

phrases.aramaic: וְעַל מַה שְּׂעִירֵי רָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים מְכַפְּרִין?
phrases.english: And for what do the goats of the New Moons atone?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְעַל מַה שְּׂעִירֵי רָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים מְכַפְּרִין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Follows directly from רבי שמעון's view in step 10, which leaves the ראש חודש goats without a stated role.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What sin the ראש חודש goats atone for according to רבי שמעון.
